clue.text: Not venturing out to support party

parts.note: to support a structure is to stay it, as a mast is stayed
an at-home is a reception held in one's own house

explanation.surface: Someone declines to go out because they are backing a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'party' reads as politics, but an AT HOME is a dated word for a social gathering at one's house.
explanation.definitionFit: A homebody who stays in is literally not venturing out of doors.

clue.text: Kate requires about an hour to do needlework

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the needlework word goes round the hour

parts.note: to sew is to do needlework
HR is the abbreviation for hour

explanation.surface: Kate needs roughly sixty minutes to finish her sewing.
explanation.walkthrough: Kate is the heroine of Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew.
explanation.definitionFit: Katherina, the scolding heroine of Shakespeare's comedy, is its title character.

clue.text: Attractive procedure for achieving fine adjustment, perhaps

definitions.text: procedure for achieving fine adjustment, perhaps
definitions.meaning: going to a higher court to reduce a monetary penalty, with fine meaning a penalty rather than precise

explanation.surface: A pleasing method for making delicate adjustments.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasing things attract; challenging a court penalty is a legal process to alter it.

clue.text: Supervisors introduced to new idea not previously considered

indicators.note: introduced to means put inside, so the supervisors go into the rearranged letters
new tells us the letters of idea not are formed afresh

parts.note: foremen supervise workers

explanation.surface: Bosses are shown a novel concept nobody had thought of before.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supervisors' suggests managers judging an idea, but they are factory FOREMEN; 'new' is the anagram signal and 'introduced to' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mentioned earlier in a text has already been dealt with or discussed.

clue.text: Ghastly retreats for outlaws time's forgotten

indicators.note: forgotten means left out, so the letter for time is dropped

parts.note: hideouts are where outlaws hide
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Outlaws' dens are grim places where the clock is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Hideous means horribly ugly, frightful.

clue.text: He provides service to make you limber, ultimately

definitions.text: He provides service to make you limber, ultimately

parts.note: Mass is a church service

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: A man performs a service that will make you supple in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes the last letters of make, you, limber: EUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A man who gives massages loosens the client's muscles.

clue.text: Stuff knocked back is brandy

indicators.note: knocked back, like a drink downed, tells us the word for stuff is read backwards

parts.note: to stuff is to cram

explanation.surface: Some liquor one has knocked back turns out to be brandy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' suggests drinking, apt for brandy, but here it turns CRAM round.
explanation.definitionFit: Marc is a French spirit distilled from grape pressings, a type of brandy.

clue.text: Part of diagram is seriously wrong

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something in a chart is badly mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something amiss has gone awry, is faulty.

clue.text: Where we may eat ice after a stew?

indicators.note: a stew is a jumbled mix, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A place to dine where ice is served after a casserole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like a dish on the menu, but is the anagram signal for ICE AFTER A.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-service restaurant is a place for a meal.

clue.text: Compared with the tip of the toe, it's irrelevant

parts.note: beside can mean compared with, as in 'beside him I am nothing'
a dancer's toe tip is the point, as in dancing on point

explanation.surface: Measured against a toe's end, something seems not to matter.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for a remark off the subject, not pertinent.

clue.text: One may draw on it for security in the fall

definitions.text: One may draw on it for security in the fall

parts.words: One may draw on it for security in the fall
parts.note: reads like drawing on savings to tide one over an autumn downturn, but describes the cord a parachutist pulls when falling

explanation.surface: An investor taps a reserve to stay safe in a market fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A parachutist pulls this cord to open the canopy, giving safety while dropping through the air.

clue.text: Book ringleader even though fellow's a lawman

parts.note: She is the novel by H. Rider Haggard
the leader of ring is its first letter, R
if, as in 'pleasant if dull', can mean even though
F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS

explanation.surface: Someone booking a gang boss may still be the law, since he's a lawman.
explanation.walkthrough: SHE is a classic novel by H. Rider Haggard; 'ringleader' splits into ring's leader, R.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheriff is a county law-enforcement officer in the US.

clue.text: Firm stays dependant on its input.

definitions.text: Firm stays dependant on its input

parts.words: Firm stays dependant on its input
parts.note: reads like a business staying reliant on investment, but describes stiff corset stays whose material comes from a great sea creature

explanation.surface: A company remains reliant on what is put into it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' and 'stays' look like business and remaining, but are adjective and noun: stiff corset supports. 'dependant' is printed thus.
explanation.definitionFit: Baleen from the mouth of the great marine mammal was the stiffening used in corsets and stays.

clue.text: Trendy group producing extra piece for magazine

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A fashionable clique produces an add-on for a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: An extra page or insert placed within a publication is so called.

clue.text: Seaboard state, not out in West

indicators.note: in tells us one piece is placed inside the name that follows it

parts.note: Mae West, the American actress
a batsman not out is still in

explanation.surface: A coastal state reports a batsman unbeaten in the western part of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' seems geographical, but it is the film star MAE West; 'not out' is cricket for still batting, IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Maine is a US state on the Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Main way lover brings in theologian as intermediary

indicators.note: brings in means takes inside, so the theologian goes into the road and lover

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI
leman is an archaic word for a lover
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian

explanation.surface: A lover on the main road picks up a theologian to act as go-between.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1, read as MI, is the main motorway from London to the north of England; LEMAN is old poetry for sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: A middleman is a go-between, a broker.

clue.text: Desire such a vehicle for actors on stage

definitions.text: Desire such a vehicle for actors on stage

parts.words: Desire such a vehicle for actors on stage
parts.note: alludes to Tennessee Williams's play whose title tram is named Desire, the play itself being a vehicle for performers

explanation.surface: An actor longs for a role that will show off their talent on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A tram in A Streetcar Named Desire, the Tennessee Williams play, gives the play its title.

clue.text: A woman deeply involved in vocal music

definitions.text: A woman deeply involved in vocal music

parts.words: A woman deeply involved in vocal music
parts.note: reads like a passionate female fan of singing, but deeply means with a low voice: a female singer of the lowest range

explanation.surface: A woman is passionately absorbed in singing.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest female singing voice belongs to this kind of singer.

clue.text: Without using hands, one's taken drug

parts.note: a digital watch shows time with numbers rather than hands
one is I, and the 's adds S

explanation.surface: Someone who took a drug lost the use of their hands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without using hands' suggests a feat, but refers to a clock or watch with a numeric display.
explanation.definitionFit: Foxglove extract is a heart medicine, a cardiac drug.

clue.text: Information depressed county

parts.note: low means depressed
Down is a county of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: News comes from a gloomy county.
explanation.walkthrough: DOWN is one of the six counties of Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: The low-down is the inside facts, the real story.

clue.text: Kick legs and poke in brawl

parts.note: to shin someone is to kick them on the legs
a dig is a poke

explanation.surface: Kicking shins and jabbing in a punch-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A shindig, like shindy, can mean a noisy row or rumpus.

clue.text: Hard woman rejected substance for treatment of shock

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the woman's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A tough woman refuses a remedy for trauma.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shock' suggests trauma; it is a shock of hair, which henna dyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Henna is a reddish dye applied to a mass of hair.

clue.text: Line round animal caught

parts.note: an ass is an animal
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A rope loops round a captured beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy's noosed rope is thrown round a beast to catch it.

clue.text: Vision is good in this set-up

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for good goes inside the rearranged word
a set-up is an arrangement, so the letters of this are reorganised

explanation.surface: Eyesight works well in this arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set-up' rearranges THIS to SIHT, and 'in' puts G inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is the faculty of seeing, eyesight.

clue.text: Said to be understood by few auditors

definitions.text: Said to be understood by few auditors

parts.words: Said to be understood by few auditors
parts.note: reads like jargon that few accountants follow, but auditors are listeners and few hear what is spoken very softly

explanation.surface: Something is stated that only a handful of accountants can grasp.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech uttered under one's breath is heard only by those nearby.

clue.text: Old hat assigned to a specific period

definitions.meaning: given a date, as when an archaeologist fixes an object's age

explanation.definitionFit: Something out of fashion is so described; so is something whose time has been fixed.

clue.text: It generates spark making one megaton explosion

indicators.note: an explosion blows the letters of megaton apart into a new order

explanation.surface: A device creating a spark sets off a huge nuclear blast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' and 'making' are link words: the letters of MEGATON alone are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A magneto is a small generator producing ignition sparks in engines.

clue.text: Wader, possibly, set back by obstruction in small stream

indicators.note: set back means turned round, so the word for wader is reversed

parts.note: a wader is an example of a bird, so 'possibly'
a let is an obstruction, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A heron is held up by a blockage in a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: A driblet is a trickle, a tiny flow of water.

clue.text: Record a piece of music

definitions.meaning: to record something in writing is to jot it down
a single musical sound is so called

explanation.definitionFit: To note is to write down; a note is a single tone in a tune.

clue.text: Dark period, say, before poet gets honour

indicators.note: say tells us the word for a dark period is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: night is the dark period of the day
Thomas Hood was an English poet

explanation.surface: During a dark time, a poet receives an honour.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas HOOD was a 19th-century English poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dubbed a knight is a royal honour.
